messages.text:
The comparison also showed Python was using Windows text-mode newlines, while the release binary writes LF bytes.

I’m switching the entrypoint to UTF-8/LF explicitly, then I’ll run a generated live-oracle verifier rather than relying on PowerShell’s rendered output.
